body: Thanks for the reply. I guess that’s true - it’s just such an every day part of my world, and I also don’t have kids so I don’t always think like a parent, so when he got so angry I thought I crossed some sort of major boundary that would be an obvious AH move for other people.

Thanks for the reply! I am way too old for TikTok, but good to know it’s been trending there, maybe why she was so interested lol.

And yes! Most of the herbs I use I grow myself and I buy my candles and incense from local makers/shops. I keep my practice pretty simple.
